channel.title: Counterwise — The Buyer's Notebook
channel.description: Question-led buying guides for air fryers and food thermometers.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Choose a format by matching it to the way you cook — not by assuming one style is universally better.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Measure the food and the space — not just the number printed on a product page.

item.title: Cleanup and counter space: the trade-offs to assess
item.description: The daily friction decides whether the appliance gets used or banished.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function appliance
item.description: A long mode list is only worth what the modes replace in your routine.

item.title: What size air fryer does a family of four actually need?
item.description: The honest answer starts with a plate count, ends with a tape measure, and never takes a quart number at face value.

item.title: Seven things to check before you click Buy
item.description: A two-minute pass that catches most buyer's remorse while it's still a browser tab.

item.title: How to use a thermometer so you never guess again
item.description: Where you probe matters as much as what you probe. The USDA numbers are simple; the placement is where dinner is won.

item.title: Wired, Bluetooth, WiFi: what each probe tier actually buys you
item.description: You're not paying for the temperature. You're paying for how far you can walk away from it.

item.title: The first week with a new air fryer
item.description: Registration, a recall habit, one throwaway test, and one frozen-dinner win — in that order.
